SELECT event_type AS eventType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM site_user_event WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() AND created_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY event_type

SELECT page_path AS pagePath, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(DISTINCT anon_id) AS uniqueVisitors, NULL AS returningRate FROM site_user_event WHERE event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW' AND created_at >= CURDATE() AND created_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY page_path ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM site_user_event WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() AND created_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND session_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT device_type AS deviceType, COUNT(DISTINCT anon_id) AS count FROM site_user_event WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() AND created_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND device_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY device_type

SELECT referrer AS referrerHost, COUNT(*) AS count FROM site_user_event WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() AND created_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND referrer IS NOT NULL AND referrer <> '' GROUP BY referrer ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT anon_id) FROM site_user_event WHERE event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW' AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end} + INTERVAL 1 DAY
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(event_count), 0) FROM site_user_event_daily WHERE event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW' AND event_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
SELECT event_type AS eventType, SUM(event_count) AS count FROM site_user_event_daily WHERE event_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY event_type

SELECT e.page_path AS pagePath, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.anon_id) AS uniqueVisitors, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.first_seen_date < #{start} THEN e.anon_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.anon_id), 1) AS returningRate FROM site_user_event e LEFT JOIN site_user_first_seen f ON f.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW' AND e.created_at >= #{start} AND e.created_at < #{end} + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY e.page_path ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT device_type AS deviceType, SUM(unique_anon_count) AS count FROM site_user_event_daily_device WHERE event_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY device_type

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessionCount, COALESCE(SUM(is_new), 0) AS pageViewCount FROM ( SELECT session_id, CASE WHEN LAG(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, page_path ORDER BY created_at) IS NULL OR LAG(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, page_path ORDER BY created_at) < created_at - INTERVAL 30 SECOND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new FROM site_user_event WHERE event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW' AND created_at >= CURDATE() AND created_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY ) t

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(event_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS bucket, COALESCE(SUM(unique_anon_count), 0) AS uniqueVisitors, COALESCE(SUM(event_count), 0) AS pageViews FROM site_user_event_daily WHERE event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW' AND event_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY event_date ORDER BY event_date

SELECT LPAD(HOUR(created_at), 2, '0') AS bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT anon_id) AS uniqueVisitors, COUNT(*) AS pageViews FROM site_user_event WHERE event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW' AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end} + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY HOUR(created_at) ORDER BY HOUR(created_at)

SELECT 'new' AS visitorType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM site_user_first_seen WHERE first_seen_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} UNION ALL SELECT 'returning' AS visitorType, COUNT(DISTINCT e.anon_id) AS count FROM site_user_event e JOIN site_user_first_seen f ON f.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW' AND e.created_at >= #{start} AND e.created_at < #{end} + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND f.first_seen_date < #{start}
